import re
from datetime import datetime

year = datetime.now().year
# Ensure entries_list exists
try:
    entries_list = entries_list
except NameError:
    entries_list = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/bills/', entry_type='files', recursive=True)

cable_2023_all = sorted([p for p in entries_list if '/bills/cable/' in p and f'/{year}-' in p])
print('cable_files_for_year_count:', len(cable_2023_all))
print('cable_files_for_year_list:', cable_2023_all)

# Use cached contents if available; otherwise fetch (shouldn't happen)
if 'contents' not in globals():
    contents = {}

# Parse amounts from cached contents for each file

def extract_total_amount(text):
    # Look for explicit Total Amount / Amount Due lines first
    patterns = [
        r'(?:Total Amount|Amount Due|Total Due)\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)',
        r'(?:Total Amount|Amount Due|Total Due)\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)',
    ]
    for pat in patterns:
        m = re.search(pat, text, flags=re.I)
        if m:
            return float(m.group(1))
    # Fallback: take first 'Total' style line containing '=>'
    m = re.search(r'Total[^\n]*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', text, flags=re.I)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))
    return None

amounts = []
for fp in cable_2023_all:
    if fp not in contents:
        resp = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=fp)
        contents[fp] = resp.get('content','')
    text = contents[fp]
    amt = extract_total_amount(text)
    amounts.append((fp, amt))
    # print evidence: line containing 'Total'
    total_lines = [ln for ln in text.splitlines() if re.search(r'Total\b', ln, flags=re.I) or re.search(r'Amount\s*Due\b', ln, flags=re.I)]
    print('\nFILE:', fp)
    print('total_line_candidates:', total_lines[:5])
    print('extracted_total_amount:', amt)

sum_total = sum(a for _, a in amounts if a is not None)
print('\namounts_extracted:', amounts)
print('sum_total:', sum_total)
